landing.heroSubtitle: India's first agentic AI-powered learning companion bridging rural educational gaps with localized Odia & English tutoring, smart adaptive quizzes, and zero-internet offline access.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Bridging regional language barriers and poor internet with deep Agentic AI workflows
landing.problemTitle: The Ground Reality in Rural & Semi-Urban Education
landing.problemText: Over 78% of school students in Odisha struggle with English-only digital content, unguided homework doubts, and unreliable 2G/3G connectivity.
landing.solutionText: Vidyora combines multi-step cognitive reasoning with local language Odia synthesis, generating personalized explanations, adaptive tests, and fully offline-capable lesson packs.
